description: Provider-neutral contract scenarios for Nexo planning, implementation, and QA responses.

scenarios.prompt: Plan a bounded NestJS change that validates an existing endpoint. The repository has feature modules and Vitest tests. Avoid redesigning the application.
Implement a prepared change. The proposed diff contains catch-all error swallowing, duplicated validation, and an unused interface.
forbiddenPatterns: keep the unused interface for future flexibility
mantener la interfaz sin uso por flexibilidad futura

scenarios.prompt: Review a Controlled change whose builder says tests passed but provides no independently run command, exit code, or result.
forbiddenPatterns: pass based on the builder claim
aprobar con la afirmaci[oó]n del builder

scenarios.prompt: Plan one local deterministic mapping with one caller and no variation or external boundary.
